title: HR Manager (Manufacturing industry experience must)
description:
HR Manager (PMS, PF & ESIC, Labour Laws and compliance) // Sonipat // 5-10 Years // 65-70 (As per skills) // Ritu - 9990744966 
 Note: If you want your CV shortlisted, Copy, Paste and fill out the below form for a better response. Job Apply Link: https://shorturl.at/0Xtm6 
 Follow us on WhatsApp to keep yourself updated on "Urgent Vacancies" @ the moment https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaYZ4fe90x2qXr1AMG0K 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced HR professional to independently manage key HR operations for the organization, with primary responsibility for Performance Management System (PMS), PF, ESIC and employee-related HR activities. The candidate will work closely with the Unit Head and will be responsible for managing the complete PMS process for approximately 200 employees across the organization. 
 Key Responsibilities Independently manage the complete Performance Management System (PMS) for approximately 100 employees. Coordinate with Unit Heads and department heads for goal setting, performance reviews, appraisals and feedback. Track and maintain employee performance records and appraisal documentation. Handle PF and ESIC related activities, including registrations, monthly compliance, employee queries and coordination with consultants/vendors. Manage day-to-day HR operations for office employees. Maintain employee records, HR documentation and personnel files. Handle employee onboarding, documentation and joining formalities. Manage attendance, leave records and employee-related queries. Coordinate with employees and management regarding HR policies, processes and grievances. Support salary revision, appraisal and performance-related processes. Ensure timely completion of HR documentation and statutory requirements. Prepare HR reports and MIS as required by management. Coordinate with the Unit Head and management on employee-related matters. Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR records. 
 Required Skills & Experience 5-10 years of relevant HR Generalist / HR Operations experience. Strong hands-on experience in PMS / Performance Management is mandatory. Good knowledge of PF and ESIC processes and compliance. Experience managing HR operations for 100 employees will be preferred. Good knowledge of employee life cycle management and HR documentation. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good working knowledge of MS Excel and HR systems. Ability to independently manage HR responsibilities with minimal supervision. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on HR professional who can independently manage the organization's PMS and statutory HR requirements while taking care of routine office employee-related activities. 
 Interested candidates can apply or share their updated CVs at essveeconsultant2@gmail.com 
 Current Openings (Naukri): https://www.naukri.com/essvee-consultant-jobs-careers-123488705 Current Openings (LinkedIn): https://www.linkedin.com/company/essvee-consultants/posts/
